The font8.bin, font14.bin and font16.bin entries in assets/front_end.dat are the IBM-compatible
BIOS fonts supplied by DOSBox, rather than artwork stored in Corncob itself.

(at your option) any later version. See GPL-2.0.txt in this directory.
Their original byte data is retained; no DOSBox runtime code is executed.
